svg.title: Part 1: one managed call retrieves, grounds, and generates
svg.desc: A question goes into one Azure OpenAI on your data call. Inside that call, the service retrieves passages from the Search index, grounds the answer in them, and generates a cited answer. The service signs in to Search with its own managed identity. The Search index is shown dashed as context.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
